page.notes: The running head is the page title as printed. The title line breaks after "PROVER", where a printed hyphen may stand; it is written whole here. The Greek in line 6 is a best reading of the scan (καρδιογνώστης) and is marked [?]. Line 2 of the politici list appears cut off at the right of the column. The right-hand numbers 1 to 24 are in the margin and are kept as notes. The "I." and "II." numerals are bare numbers and are written as paragraphs.
